title: Interior Designer Portfolio
description: Gives the designer a polished portfolio that is easier to verify, share, and use in project conversations.
constraints: The site had to make premium work feel premium online without burying it in a heavy browsing experience.
problem: The designer's work was hard to find and verify online. Without a professional website, he relied on word of mouth and an outdated social media presence to reach potential clients.
solution: Designed and built a fast portfolio site that lets the work carry the pitch. It uses immersive project presentation, high-quality imagery, and a clear path to consultation without clutter.
result: He now has a site that makes the work easier to share and supports pitches for larger interior design projects without relying on scattered social content.
